shortlist.label: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: EBV-positive and CD56-positive, consistent with this lymphoma subtype

shortlist.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD138-positive and EBV-positive, consistent with this aggressive lymphoma

shortlist.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive nature and lack of specific immunophenotypic markers

shortlist.label: Nasal cavity squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Polypoid mass and potential for aggressive behavior

shortlist.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Unilateral nasal obstruction and polypoid mass, although less likely given the immunophenotypic profile

raw.rationale: The presence of CD138 and CD56 positivity, along with EBV positivity and the absence of CD20 and PAX5 expression, are characteristic of Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma. The gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, including 3q27 (BCL6), 8q24 (MYC), and 14q32 (IGH), also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
rejected.why: CD138 positivity can be seen in plasmablastic lymphoma, but the lack of CD20 and PAX5 expression, along with EBV positivity, makes Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma more likely

rejected.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
rejected.why: This diagnosis does not typically show the specific immunophenotypic and genetic features seen in this case, such as CD56 positivity and EBV positivity

rejected.label: Nasal cavity squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: This diagnosis would not typically show the immunophenotypic features seen in this case, such as CD138 and CD56 positivity, and would not be expected to be EBV-positive

rejected.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
rejected.why: This diagnosis would not typically show the immunophenotypic and genetic features seen in this case, such as CD138 and CD56 positivity, and would not be expected to be EBV-positive
